run_mingw_cli: run the mingw CLI to download a specific MinGW version for a given architecture
build_mingw_root: build the MinGW root directory by downloading and unpacking a specific compiler variant
test_repository: test the repository function to fetch and parse available MinGW-builds versions from SourceForge
create_download_mingw: create a download and unpack operation for a MinGW-builds archive to a target location
refactor_unpack_archive: refactor the unpack function to extract a MinGW-builds archive using 7zip to a directory
